g.text: The steps outlined in this chapter will result in the following outputs (Fig. 10):
Consistent and timely access to quality medicines and medical products for the population, through seamless
supply chain enabled by technologies that provide efficient tools for providers
to provide timely access to quality
Digital transformation handbook for health supply chain architecture
